ordering: Pure normalization, duplicate/compatibility lookup and previews occur before BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Authoritative commands then resolve idempotency, revalidate exact current projections/dependencies, insert one command_receipt, append owned facts/relationships, rebuild affected projections/audit and commit.

commands.name: CreateSpareNeedDraft
steps: normalize BOM outside lock
inside one UoW require the Service Request exists and no different active Need already owns the same SR+BOM key
allocate immutable spare_need_id and insert one command receipt
insert manual Spare Need root, one created lifecycle event, the active SR+BOM key and revision-1 current projection with contributor_count=0
append inventory.spare_need.changed.v1 CREATE audit and commit
rules: manual creation is planning authority only and creates no Device Part contributor, Stock reservation, Spare Request allocation or fulfillment evidence
same SR+BOM may have at most one active Need; a competing active Need fails INV_STALE rather than silently merging identities
an untouched manual Need is eligible for HardDeleteUntouchedInventoryDraft under exact destructive preview revalidation

commands.name: RegisterDevicePartUnit
steps: normalize BOM/serial outside lock and show duplicate candidates
inside UoW revalidate SR↔Device Reference operational context
allocate immutable device_part_unit_id and stable creation_sequence
insert receipt/unit/registered event and optional fault_observed event
run NEED_AGGREGATION_V1 for same SR+BOM: create active Need if absent or add contributor to existing active Need without changing planned_quantity
rebuild Device Part/Need projections and audit/commit
rules: matching serial/BOM never silently merges identities
fault registration may aggregate Need automatically

commands.name: SetSpareNeedPlannedQuantity
steps: inside UoW require current Need and exact revision
insert receipt/planned_quantity_changed event
rebuild Need projection only; contributor count unchanged
audit/commit
commands.rule: planned quantity is independent of contributor/request/local quantities

commands.name: ChangeSpareNeedLifecycle
steps: inside UoW revalidate active/nonactive key and request dependencies
history_remove requires every associated request terminal cancelled/rejected and preserves allocations/history
reactivate requires no competing active SR+BOM Need; restore active key
insert receipt/lifecycle event, update active key/rebuild projection/audit/commit
rules: history removal is not hard delete

commands.name: RegisterSparePartUnit
steps: normalize keys and show duplicate candidates
inside UoW revalidate optional RMA provenance and no identity adoption conflict

for extracted origin require an existing parent Spare Part Unit that is the current rma_direct_inbound_units target for its non-null origin_rma_id and require supplied origin RMA to equal that parent provenance
allocate a fresh immutable unit id and LSU for the child; never reuse parent identity/tracking
insert receipt/unit/registered lifecycle event with parent_spare_part_unit_id; do not create direct-inbound or logistics occurrence rows for the child
rebuild unit projection/Stock eligibility and audit/commit
rules: local unit without official provenance is valid
later adoption of RMA provenance for an existing local unit uses CorrectInventoryEvidence(spare_part_rma_provenance) and preserves the same physical identity/LSU/history
extracted child is a distinct physical identity that shares parent RMA provenance only; the parent remains the sole direct inbound/logistics unit

commands.name: ReserveSparePartUnitForTask
steps: outside lock preview Stock eligibility
inside UoW revalidate Task exists, unit current Stock eligibility, no active allocation/installation/return conflict and optional Need relation
insert receipt/reserve allocation event/current row
rebuild unit Stock projection and audit/commit
rules: one active Task allocation per unit
reservation is planning only and never proves use/installation or changes Task lifecycle

commands.name: ReleaseSparePartUnitReservation
steps: inside UoW require exact active planning relationship and no physical consequence that depends on it as immutable history
insert receipt/release event/remove current allocation
rebuild unit Stock eligibility/audit/commit

commands.name: RecordLocalNeedFulfillmentSelection
steps: inside UoW revalidate Need active and unit available/compatible
insert receipt/local selected event
optionally reserve through same Task allocation semantics
rebuild Need quantity summary and unit projection/audit/commit
commands.rule: selection does not consume/resolve Need automatically
